selection_method: Human-directed source choice from frozen code-ranked 50, based on grain, publisher, actual format and accessible samples. No ontology mappings are manually specified.

selected_sources.title: ASIC - Company Dataset
selected_sources.reason: Authoritative company register; explicit ACN/ABN and historical name rows; identity anchor.

selected_sources.title: ASIC - Business Names Dataset
selected_sources.reason: Business-name owner relationships; tests business name versus legal entity and one owner to many names.

selected_sources.title: QBCC Licensed Contractors Register
selected_sources.reason: Contractor licences and classes, mixed company/individual licensees; distinct licensing publisher.

selected_sources.title: Corporate Tax Transparency
selected_sources.reason: Real multi-sheet XLSX, reporting years and tax-entity ABNs; Information is not an entity table.

selected_sources.title: Suitable Operator Register (SOR) for Environmentally Relevant Activities (ERAs)
selected_sources.reason: Independent environmental register XLSX; typed Business Number, person/corporation grain, Excel serial dates.

selected_sources.title: Contracts Register - 2000 to 2016
selected_sources.actual_read_format: Native Socrata JSON (not CKAN CSV projection)
selected_sources.reason: Native JSON of historical contracts; contractor/supplier role, repeated contracts and historical attributes.

exploratory_not_selected.reason: Historical candidate is outside frozen shortlist50; retained as exploratory evidence.

sample_bias: Primary intake samples are file/API-order prefixes, not random population samples. Targeted ASIC queries are separately labelled overlap diagnostics.
